news.title: U.S. DOT Road Safety Innovation Expo
news.text: Attended the U.S. Department of Transportation's Road Safety Innovation Expo in Washington, D.C., exploring the latest work in roadway safety, connected systems and emerging technologies, and connecting with professionals working toward safer, smarter transportation.

news.title: iTPAS poster at TRB 2026
news.text: Our team presented a poster on the Innovative Truck Parking Availability System (iTPAS) at the TRB Annual Meeting. iTPAS uses computer vision to monitor truck parking at Florida highway rest areas in real time and shares live availability through Florida 511 and dynamic message signs.

news.title: Florida Automated Vehicles (FAV) Summit 2025
news.text: This year's summit focused on Advanced Air Mobility, with operations in Florida expected by the end of 2026. Other highlights included autonomous shuttles, trucks and trains, drone delivery, and Waymo's safety findings. Proud to be part of the AtkinsRéalis and FDOT District 2 team working on intelligent transportation systems.

news.title: AtkinsRéalis at UF Career Week
news.text: Back on campus at the University of Florida with the AtkinsRéalis team for Career Week Technical Day, meeting students interested in transportation and engineering careers.

news.title: AtkinsRéalis at ESSIE, University of Florida

news.title: Graduated with an M.S. from the University of Florida
news.text: Completed my Master's in Civil Engineering (Transportation) at UF. As a Graduate Research Assistant I worked on the Gainesville Pedestrian and Bicyclist Connected Vehicle Pilot with FDOT, the City of Gainesville and technology vendors. Thank you to my advisors, Dr. Lily Elefteriadou and Dr. Pruthvi Manjunatha, and to my wife and family for their support. Go Gators!
